nisha: Quick thread  small docs refresh: sync quickstart snippets to SDK v8, retire REDWOOD_API_KEY in examples, add tiny migration note, and replace the Dockerfile with a compact multistage. I9ll open a PR in ~25m.
tara: Thanks. Can you paste the JS/Py snippets so I can run snippet-runner?
nisha: JS:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN });
const r = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'Hello!' });
console.log(r.output_text || r.output[0].content);
```
PY:
```py
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(token=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_TOKEN'))
res = client.text.generate(model='redwood-alpha', prompt='Hello!')
print(getattr(res, 'output_text', res.output[0].content))
```
